description: Client-side script for managing widget interactions in the OrchardCore Flow editor, including adding, inserting, deleting widgets, and updating widget UI elements.

methods.name: add-widget click handler
methods.description: Handles adding a new widget via AJAX and appending the content to the target element.

methods.name: insert-widget click handler
methods.description: Handles inserting a widget before a template element via AJAX.

methods.name: widget-delete click handler
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a widget, then triggers content preview re-render.

methods.name: widget-editor label change handler
methods.description: Updates widget size and alignment UI based on user input.

methods.name: widget-editor toggle button click handler
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the widget editor.

methods.name: content-caption keyup handler
methods.description: Updates widget header text based on caption input.
